entries.title: Galatians 6:1
segments: ¶Brethren, if a man is overtaken in any trespass, you who [are] spiritual restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, considering yourself lest you also be tempted.

entries.title: Galatians 6:2
segments: Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 6:3
segments: For if anyone thinks himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

entries.title: Galatians 6:4
segments: But let each one examine his own work, and then he will have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

entries.title: Galatians 6:5
segments: For each one shall bear his own load.

entries.title: Galatians 6:6
segments: Let him who is taught the word share in all good things with him who teaches.

entries.title: Galatians 6:7
segments: Do not be deceived, God is not mocked; for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

entries.title: Galatians 6:8
segments: For he who sows to his flesh will of the flesh reap corruption, but he who sows to the Spirit will of the Spirit reap everlasting life.

entries.title: Galatians 6:9
segments: And let us not grow weary while doing good, for in due season we shall reap if we do not lose heart.

entries.title: Galatians 6:10
segments: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all, especially to those who are of the household of faith.

entries.title: Galatians 6:11
segments: ¶See with what large letters I have written to you with my own hand!

entries.title: Galatians 6:12
segments: As many as desire to make a good showing in the flesh, these [would] compel you to be circumcised, only that they may not suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.

entries.title: Galatians 6:13
segments: For not even those who are circumcised keep the law, but they desire to have you circumcised that they may boast in your flesh.

entries.title: Galatians 6:14
segments: But God forbid that I should boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

entries.title: Galatians 6:15
segments: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision avails anything, but a new creation.

entries.title: Galatians 6:16
segments: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace and mercy [be] upon them, and upon the Israel of God.

entries.title: Galatians 6:17
segments: From now on let no one trouble me, for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: Galatians 6:18
segments: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your spirit. Amen.
